facts.text: A seven-foot undead brown skeleton in rusted armor and a mustachioed death mask, dragging a huge greatsword, has appeared in the doorway of Sir Brandon's tomb as the party prepares to leave. The goblins say it killed many of their friends, and the slime in the pool says it is half dead, very mad and undead.

The goblins say one of the figures in the antechamber mosaics is still alive, very big with a huge sword. Is the undead giant Alfred, Brandon's shaggy greatsword-wielding companion shown in the mosaics?
